title: Assignment-scope evaluator SPI, structural verification and membership split
summary: Core performs structural verification and calls the new `AssignmentScopeEvaluator` (`validate`, `allows`, `allowsMany`) at every scope eligibility point; the existing eligibility and filter-validation code becomes `Scopes\Internal\ScopeEvaluator` (body `Scopes\Internal\ScopeEligibility`, validation `Scopes\Internal\ScopeConfiguration`) contributed by `ScopesPlugin`; tenant membership stays a core restriction and scope membership becomes a module restriction; `MembershipConfigured` is split likewise; an evaluator contract suite ships.
why: architecture#scope-boundary evaluator SPI and call-site table: the scalar, batch and write paths must share one eligibility semantics through a named contract instead of core importing `ScopeEligibility`, filters and membership (I2 entries owner P3 become fixable now). Hard risks: `allows()` may only narrow and is called only after structural verification; `allowsMany()` must keep batch preparation single-pass and fail the set on a length mismatch; failure kinds/reasons (`assignment_scope_filter_error`, `context_not_accepted` with cause) and revocation never consulting the evaluator (I7) must not change.

include: New `Contracts\Scopes\AssignmentScopeEvaluator` and `Contracts\Scopes\QueryableAssignmentScopeEvaluator` exactly as knowledge/contracts#scopes (the queryable method is implemented in P2.10; until then ScopeEvaluator implements only the base interface)

`Authorization\ScopeEligibility` → `Scopes\Internal\ScopeEligibility` (type-map relocate P2/P3: FQCN changes now, file under src/Scopes/Internal per D17) as the body of new `Scopes\Internal\ScopeEvaluator`; module code reads membership/adapters/settings from `Panel::options(ScopesOptions::class)` of the runtime's panel, never from an application-wide binding

`Scopes\ScopeConfiguration` filter/binding validation → `Scopes\Internal\ScopeConfiguration`, invoked through `AssignmentScopeEvaluator::validate()` from the panel and role compilers (compile-time `DefinitionException` preserved)

Core call sites per architecture#scope-boundary 'Call sites that change': `BoundaryStage` (mode → alias → resolve → structural → `allows(Access, role null)`), `AuthorityStage` contribution qualification (`allows(Access, role + contribution)`), `BatchInputs`/`BatchEvaluation` (`allowsMany` once per prepared set), `ChangeValidator::{tenancy,eligibility,scopeMember}` (`allows(Assignment, proposed)`), `PanelAdmission`/`WithinContext`/`ContextIdentity`/`RoleCompiler`/`SchemaBuilder` (declaration and definitions only)

`Scopes\MembershipRestriction` split: `Tenancy\Internal\TenantMembershipRestriction` (core, registered by core) + `Scopes\Internal\ScopeMembershipRestriction` (contributed by `ScopesPlugin`, with `FiltersAccessQueries` for SQL)

`Diagnostics\Checks\MembershipConfigured` split: `Diagnostics\Internal\Checks\TenantMembershipConfigured` (core) + `Scopes\Internal\Checks\ScopeMembershipConfigured` (key `scopes.membership`, finding id `membership.configured`, contributed by ScopesPlugin) — knowledge/identities#doctor

New `Testing\Contracts\AssignmentScopeEvaluatorContractTests` (Spi(Call)): narrowing-only, verification-before-call, allowsMany length/order, exception mapping; run against ScopeEvaluator and an independent test evaluator

i2.json entries for ScopeEligibility, AssignmentScopeFilter/AccessAdapter/Membership imports in BatchInputs/BatchEvaluation/AuthorityStage/BoundaryStage/ChangeValidator/SchemaBuilder removed as fixed; I4 entries of module code fixed
Migration lines: custom scope eligibility via AssignmentScopeEvaluator; doctor key scopes.membership
